node.title: Re^2: Is there a "standard" way to link to other modules in POD for a CPAN module?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I agree with this and just wanted to add a note: One of the POD to HTML converters (I forget which one) always turned a link like L into something that looked like this: "[mod://File::Spec|the File::Spec manpage]" (or something to that effect), which of course wasn't very helpful when inserted into various sentences, so I had to take to writing things like "the L documentation". A little annoying but I guess it's better to be explicit.
